name: Come, Follow Me — For Home and Church 2026 (Old Testament)
author: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
description: The official Come, Follow Me curriculum for 2026. Primary source for weekly lesson themes, key questions, and study prompts.

name: Church Newsroom — 2026 Old Testament Resources
author: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
description: Official Church resources supporting Old Testament study and teaching in 2026.

name: The Best Is Yet to Be
author: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland
description: Contains Elder Holland's memorable teaching on Lot's wife — 'Don't look back.' Directly relevant to Genesis 19:26.

name: The Abrahamic Test
author: President James E. Faust
description: President Faust on the seed of Abraham and the nature of Abrahamic tests in our lives.

name: If Ye Be Willing and Obedient
author: President Gordon B. Hinckley
description: President Hinckley on God's protective care — cited in Church News verified quote compilation for Genesis 18-23.

name: The Abrahamic Test
author: Larry E. Dahl
description: Sperry Symposium Classics. Analysis of Genesis 22 — everyone who achieves exaltation must pass an Abrahamic test. Includes Joseph Smith's teachings to the Twelve on trials.

name: Elements of Sacrifice in Abraham's Time and Our Own
author: BYU Religious Studies Center
description: Five elements of sacrifice in Genesis 22: place, identity, fire, obedience, provision. Moriah as temple/mountaintop. Altars as conduits between heaven and earth.

name: Abraham: A Man of Relationships
author: Aaron Schade
description: Sister-wife theme in Genesis 12 and 20. Sarah and Hagar complexities. Hebrew 'nissah' means 'try/prove' not 'tempt.' Abraham's laconic obedience.

name: Insights into the Book of Genesis (JST focus)
author: BYU Religious Studies Center
description: JST Genesis 18:23 — the three messengers were 'holy men, sent forth after the order of God' (Melchizedek Priesthood). Critical for understanding the divine visitors to Abraham.

name: The Abrahamic Covenant: A Foundational Theme for the Old Testament
author: BYU Religious Studies Center
description: Three covenant promises: land, seed, gospel/priesthood. Genesis 18:18-19 and 22:17-18 as key covenant passages.

name: Genesis (RSC Translation with Commentary)
author: BYU Religious Studies Center
description: Faithful English translation directly from Hebrew with LDS commentary. JST additions placed in original context. Full Genesis coverage.

name: What Have Church Leaders Said About Genesis 18-23?
author: Church News
description: Church News weekly verified quote compilation for Week 9. Includes President Faust on the seed of Abraham, Elder Holland on Lot's wife, President Hinckley on God's protective care. Each quote includes full attribution.

name: Scripture Central
author: Scripture Central
description: Academic-quality Come, Follow Me content. Multiple weekly series including KnoWhy articles, Finding Christ in the Old Testament (John Hilton III), and Handmaidens, Harems & Heroines (Lynne Hilton Wilson).

name: Follow Him Podcast
author: Hank Smith & John Bytheway
description: Weekly two-part interview podcast with guest scholars. One of the most popular CFM podcasts. Free show notes and transcripts in four languages.

name: Don't Miss This
author: Dave Butler & Grace Freeman
description: Weekly video and podcast. Devotional/inspirational style with wide appeal. Massive following. Weekly study materials and prayer posters.

name: Talking Scripture
author: Bryce Dunford
description: Weekly conversational deep dives with strong temple and covenant focus.

name: Unshaken Saints
author: Jared Halverson
description: Verse-by-verse deep dives (2-4 hrs per episode). Closest format to EVM's Deep Dive. Strong faith-crisis support angle. Archive includes full 2022 OT cycle.

name: Meridian Magazine
author: Scot & Maurine Proctor
description: Written depth with Holy Land context. Podcast and article format. Faithful LDS perspective with devotional tone.

name: Teaching with Power
author: Benjamin Wilcox
description: Practical teaching ideas for Gospel Doctrine and Sunday School teachers. Literary approach with downloadable lesson materials, slides, and handouts.

name: BYUtv Come Follow Up
author: BYUtv
description: Weekly panel discussion with guest scholars. High production quality. Re-airing 2022 OT episodes for 2026 season.

name: LDS Daily
author: LDS Daily
description: Weekly study guides with historical context, reflection questions, and curated leader quotes. Also aggregates links to other creators.

name: Gospel Grab Bag
author: Gospel Grab Bag
description: Printable lesson activities and visuals for Primary, family home evening, and families with children ages 1-16.

name: Church News
author: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
description: Publishes weekly 'What Have Church Leaders Said' articles for every CFM week — pre-verified prophetic quotes with full attribution. Key systematic source for sources_registry.json population.

name: One Minute Scripture Study
author: Cali Black
description: Daily short-form podcast (1-5 min per episode), 5x/week aligned to CFM. Bite-sized scripture insights for busy members. One of the most popular daily formats. Episodes not easily indexable via web search — live in podcast apps.
